notes.title: CLeM Patch 1.0.3 - Japanese Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42079719/859386de21c82679e5e930519c70c31b6aeef56e.gif

Hi everyone, 

We’re excited to share some fantastic news with you all: CLeM is now officially available on Nintendo Switch in Japan! It's been a great journey, and, with the help from Kakehashi for the updated localization, we couldn't be more delighted to bring the magic of CLeM to our friends in Japan.

But wait, there's more! We've also been hard at work enhancing the Japanese Steam version. We've listened to your feedback and have updated the localization to ensure that every aspect of the game feels seamless and immersive for Japanese speakers. 

We've also been keeping a keen eye on any pesky bugs that may have crept into the game. We identified a minor bug that we’re able to fix:

- Fixed an asset rendering issue after solving the reclamation puzzle in the tool shed.

We want to take this moment to express our deepest gratitude to all of you for your support and enthusiasm for CLeM. Your feedback, encouragement, and passion inspire us to continuously strive for excellence, and we couldn't do it without you.

Thanks so much for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861440/CLeM/

notes.title: CLeM Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you to all who have spotted some minor game issues and bugs! With this, we’d like to release a small update based on your feedback that aims to address these minor issues.

Changelog 1.0.1:

 The game will not save if the player goes back to the main menu without getting the notebook after waking up.
 Changed CLeM’s voice when solving the wine library puzzle so it’s not the same when solving the previous puzzle.
 Repositioned and resized the “blocked” UI label for the east corridor to hall door interaction (5th loop), ensuring that it’s always rendered on screen for all languages.
 Fixed rendering issues with some “ghost images” on close puzzle views and in the credits (thanks to the feedback from our localisation partner, Kakehashi).
 Fixed a typo on “HELICIDAE”.
 Steam Deck version will have a bigger notebook to improve readability.

Thank you again for your feedback to improve the gaming experience in CLeM!



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861440/CLeM/

notes.title: New Art Book release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42079719/82cca8c052fa5f8e32fbc83f617ae18aa0f5872f.png

Hello pretty crawlies ^_^ !

We are delighted to finally be sharing something very special with you. Cue drumroll… The CLeM Art Book! We are celebrating CLeM’s first monthiversary (oh, they grow up so fast..) and today is International Women’s Day, so we couldn’t think of a better gesture than launching the art book featuring the art director’s (AKA my) commentary.

The book has 50 pages filled with concept art, never-seen-before sketches, photos of the house that CLeM’s environments are based on and its furniture… All this content is spiced up by comments including extra info and in-depth details on certain elements and scenes. It’s the perfect chance to peek into this open window of our latest game’s creative and crafting process.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2817940/CLeM__Digital_Art_Book/

We hope you enjoy this art book we have put together. Please, don’t hesitate to share any thoughts and comments with us through social media or Discord. We’ll be thrilled to read all of them!

Mariona

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42079719/f496a5842d7ac81e5fd68a8b8ce7d22ddc59b13c.jpg

notes.title: CLeM’s Prologue Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We’re happy to announce the prologue for CLeM, CLeM: The First Attribute, is almost here and will be released on January 16th, 2024!

To summarise, the prologue will showcase the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. The prologue will also come in 11 languages, which include English, French, German, Spanish, Catalan, Dutch, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese. Whether you've been eagerly anticipating the opportunity to experience CLeM or are looking to get a jumpstart on the game, this is the perfect moment to seize your chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722310/CLeM_The_First_Attribute/

For those who have played the demo in the past, the Prologue will be similar when it comes to content and length.

Hope you're excited, and let's make this journey together!

notes.title: CLeM Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It’s been almost 2 years since we revealed CLeM, the fourth game in the Psychotic Adventures series, to the world. Now, we're thrilled to announce that the game is set to release on February 6th, 2024! 

To mark this occasion, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer that’ll take you into the mystical world of CLeM! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=BuiYImHSR9o;full]https://youtu.be/BuiYImHSR9o[/previewyoutube]

We’ve also decided on a price point for the game: $15.99. In addition, we’ll be adding a 10% discount on launch day!

We want to send a massive, heartfelt thank you to all those who’ve been following and supporting CLeM up to this point! As we close in on the crucial release phase that will determine CLeM's success, we invite you to join our Discord and contribute to making it as successful as possible!

We hope that you are as excited about the imminent release of CLeM as we are! 

Wishlist the game now!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861440/CLeM/

notes.title: An Update About the Demo
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We want to share a minor update with you today since we value transparency in keeping you informed about our current demo. We're making some changes to our approach and want to express our gratitude for the incredible support you've shown over the past years, especially those who have reported issues and bugs in the demo—your feedback is invaluable.

To bring CLeM and its intricate story to more people around the world, we've decided to take down the demo temporarily. This step is aimed at refining the user experience, and we're thrilled to announce that we'll be re-releasing it soon as a free prologue, CLeM: The First Attribute! 

CLeM: The First Attribute is a free prologue that offers the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Your support has been crucial, and we eagerly anticipate your continued feedback as we navigate through this phase through our Discord, social media, or on Steam's discussion page.

Stay tuned, and thank you for being an integral part of our community. Help us by wishlisting CLeM: The First Attribute, and let's make this journey together!



https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722310/CLeM_The_First_Attribute/
